reviews.decision_reason: The selection step preserves all eight input rows and its explicit fallback path, but the package only supplies scored need labels and source weights. It does not expose observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes supporting those demand scores, so the demand-bearing nature of the selected rows cannot be validated under the strict market-demand criteria.

The normalization step retains the allowed record identifiers n06-r01 through n06-r08, coerces expected fields, applies the bounded eight-row window, and matches the upstream needs handoff shown in the package. No behavioral defect is visible in this boundary from the supplied semantic/source/log evidence.

The provenance assembly step deterministically ranks normalized records by descending demand_score and record_id tie-break, producing the evidence_sources handoff used downstream. The supplied output preserves all eight record/source/source_weight rows with ranks that match the input scores. No local fault is visible here.
